key.name: theme
key.description: Theme id used for the collapsed pill: a built-in ('notch', 'gnome', 'blur') or the id of a user theme JSON in ~/.config/orbit/themes/.

key.name: theme-open
key.description: Theme id used for the expanded notch and notification banner, or 'same' to follow the collapsed theme. The fill crossfades between the two during the open/close animation.

key.name: closed-width
key.description: Width of the notch in its collapsed (idle) state, in pixels.

key.name: closed-height
key.description: Height of the notch in its collapsed state, in pixels. Normally overridden to match the top bar height.

key.name: open-width
key.description: Width of the notch when fully expanded, in pixels.

key.name: open-height
key.description: Height of the notch when fully expanded, in pixels.

key.name: notif-ignore-apps
key.description: Notifications whose app name matches an entry (case-insensitive) are never peeked or listed by the notch.

key.name: notif-width
key.description: Width of the transient notification peek banner, in pixels.

key.name: lyrics-width
key.description: Width of the collapsed pill while lyrics mode is showing synced lyrics, in pixels.

key.name: open-on-hover
key.description: Expand the notch automatically when the pointer hovers it.

key.name: hover-open-delay-ms
key.description: How long the pointer must dwell on the notch before it expands, in milliseconds. Prevents accidental activation when the cursor merely passes through; 0 expands immediately. Clicking always opens instantly.

key.name: hover-close-delay-ms
key.description: How long after the pointer leaves before the notch collapses, in milliseconds. A small debounce stops the notch snapping shut when the cursor briefly clips its edge.

key.name: hover-hint
key.description: Subtly swell the closed pill while the hover-open delay counts down, acknowledging the hover before the notch commits to expanding.

key.name: accent-from-art
key.description: Derive an accent colour from the current album art and tint the progress bar with it.

key.name: show-visualizer
key.description: Show album art and a live Cava equaliser on the closed pill while media is playing.

key.name: visualizer-bars
key.description: Number of bars in the Cava-driven equaliser.

key.name: visualizer-bar-width
key.description: Width of each equaliser bar, in pixels.

key.name: enable-gradient
key.description: Fill the open popup with a slowly-moving gradient derived from the album art.

key.name: enable-notifications
key.description: Briefly expand the notch to show incoming notifications.

key.name: notif-peek-seconds
key.description: How long the notification peek stays open, in seconds.

key.name: enable-shelf
key.description: Show a temporary files shelf; expand the notch when files are dragged onto it.

key.name: enable-lyrics
key.description: Fetch synced lyrics for the playing song and show a lyrics button.

key.name: lyrics-mode
key.description: Persisted state of lyrics mode: when on, the collapsed notch widens to show album art, scrolling lyrics and a visualizer.

key.name: shortcut-play-pause
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to toggle media play/pause.

key.name: shortcut-next
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to skip to next media track.

key.name: shortcut-previous
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to skip to previous media track.

key.name: shortcut-toggle-notch
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to expand or collapse the notch.
